newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico stocks extend slip, await Q2 earnings.
newsitem.headline: Mexico stocks extend slip, await Q2 earnings.

text.p: Mexican stocks extended their early dip on moderate profit-taking after last week's record rally with volume thinned by investors awaiting second-quarter corporate earnings, traders said.
"There is some profit-taking, but it's far from a sell-off," a floor trader said. "The market is on hold while waiting for second quarter earnings to confirm the recent rally."
The leading IPC share index was down 18.23 points, or 0.38 percent, but still above the pyschological 4,800-point barrier at 4,803.39.
